capabilities: Start and stop timers for notes
Review work totals and overlap warnings
disambiguation: Not a task tracker; it records note-level work intervals and status events.
extras: Preview; not registered in the Community Plugins directory; no account, telemetry or background network service; live desktop and Android behavior unverified.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to log note-level work intervals or status history as linked records.

relations.evidence: planned read-only records/relations functions in Bases Excerpts

summary: Time-tracking plugin that records note work intervals and status events as linked Markdown notes with YAML properties.
